additions.name: Shodan
additions.description: Search engine indexing banners from internet-connected devices, queried by IP, service, product, or geography to find exposed servers, cameras, and industrial systems.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: free account gets very limited search credits and results per query; meaningful use requires a paid membership.

additions.name: Censys
additions.description: Internet-wide scanning platform searchable by host, certificate, or web-property attributes to map exposed services and TLS infrastructure.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: Censys Free gives 100 credits/month for search and lookups, capped at 100 results per query, with no historical host data or advanced protocols.

additions.name: ZoomEye
additions.description: Chinese internet-scanning search engine indexing device fingerprints, open ports, and web application banners, queried with dork-style syntax.
additions.notes: Free tier restricted to a small daily query/result quota; full history and export need a paid plan.

additions.name: FOFA
additions.description: Internet asset search engine indexing device banners, favicon hashes, and certificates, with strong coverage of Asian infrastructure.
additions.notes: Free tier limited to roughly 10 queries/day and reduced result counts; paid tiers unlock full data and export.

additions.name: Criminal IP
additions.description: Threat-intelligence search engine combining internet-wide scan data, malicious IP scoring, and exposed asset search.
additions.notes: Free registration gives a limited daily search-credit allowance; deeper history and bulk export require paid credits.

additions.name: ONYPHE
additions.description: Cyber-defense search engine indexing internet scan data, passive DNS, and threat-intelligence feeds, operated from the EU.
additions.notes: Free View is limited to 1 query/minute and 10 results, with some services withheld by policy; paid Butterfly/Enterprise views remove those limits.

additions.name: Hunter.how
additions.description: Internet-asset search engine for exposed hosts and devices, searchable by IP, domain, port, product, or certificate.
additions.notes: Free daily search quota per account; monthly subscriptions raise the quota and add API/bulk search.

additions.name: Netlas.io
additions.description: Internet-scanning and intelligence platform for host responses, DNS, WHOIS, and certificate data across billions of indexed hosts.
additions.notes: Free Community tier gives 50 requests/day and 2,500 results/month; Domain WHOIS and Certificates search are paid-only.

additions.name: LeakIX
additions.description: Search engine indexing exposed services, misconfigurations, and leaked data discovered through internet-wide scanning.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: browsing is free; full-text search and API access require a free account, subject to fair-use rate limits.

additions.name: crt.sh
additions.description: Certificate Transparency log search engine; look up a domain or organization to enumerate its issued TLS certificates and subdomains.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: still entirely free with no account, though the service (run by Sectigo) is a single point of failure and occasionally has downtime.

additions.name: SecurityTrails
additions.description: Historical DNS and domain-intelligence database for WHOIS history, passive DNS, and infrastructure changes over time.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: free tier capped around 50 API queries/month; paid Business plans start near $50/month for real research volume.

additions.name: DNSlytics
additions.description: Reverse IP, WHOIS, and ad/analytics-ID lookup tool used to pivot between domains sharing hosting or tracking infrastructure.
additions.notes: Limited free lookups per day before a paid plan is required for bulk or repeated pivoting.

additions.name: SecurityHeaders
additions.description: Free scanner that grades a website's HTTP response headers for security misconfigurations.
additions.notes: Fully free, no account required, as of September 2026.

additions.name: Wayback Machine CDX API
additions.description: Programmatic API to query the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine index for every captured snapshot of a given URL.
additions.notes: Free and keyless; rate-limited but no registration needed as of Sept 2026.

additions.name: Amass
additions.description: Open-source command-line tool for attack-surface mapping and subdomain enumeration using OSINT and active reconnaissance techniques.
additions.notes: Free, open-source OWASP project, actively maintained as of 2026.

additions.name: subfinder
additions.description: Open-source passive subdomain-discovery tool that aggregates results from many third-party sources through a single CLI.
additions.notes: Free and open source; some upstream sources it queries require their own API keys for higher rate limits.

additions.name: dnsx
additions.description: Fast, open-source DNS toolkit for bulk resolution and DNS record enumeration, built to pair with subfinder and httpx.
additions.notes: Free and open source.

additions.name: RDAP (Registration Data Access Protocol)
additions.description: Standardized successor to WHOIS; query a domain, IP block, or ASN to get structured registration data straight from the authoritative registry.
additions.notes: Free, keyless, no registration; IANA's bootstrap routes each query to the correct registry's RDAP server.

additions.name: Flightradar24
additions.description: Live flight-tracking map built from ADS-B/MLAT feeds, searchable by flight number, aircraft registration, or airport.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: free web view shows live positions with a short data delay and ads; historical playback and full undelayed data need a paid subscription.

additions.name: ADS-B Exchange
additions.description: Crowdsourced, unfiltered ADS-B flight-tracking map that, unlike most trackers, does not hide aircraft on government block-request lists.
additions.notes: Live map remains free to browse without an account; the API and historical-data downloads are paid.

additions.name: ADSB.fi
additions.description: Free, volunteer-run global ADS-B flight tracker and public API positioned as an open alternative to commercial trackers.
additions.notes: Entirely free community project, including its public API, as of 2026.

additions.name: OpenSky Network
additions.description: Non-profit ADS-B sensor network providing live and historical air-traffic data for research, with a public API and web map.
additions.notes: Live map and a limited API call allowance are free; bulk historical data needs network-contributor status or a paid Impala/S3 tier.

additions.name: planespotters.net
additions.description: Database of aircraft photos and registration histories, searchable by tail number to identify an aircraft's operator and past liveries.
additions.notes: Browsing and search remain free as of 2026; an account is only needed to upload photos.

additions.name: VesselFinder
additions.description: AIS-based live ship-tracking map searchable by vessel name, IMO/MMSI number, or port.
additions.notes: Free tier shows live positions with limited track history; full history, satellite AIS, and API access are paid.

additions.name: FleetMon
additions.description: AIS ship-tracking and maritime database offering vessel profiles, port-call history, and fleet-monitoring tools.
additions.notes: Free live-map access; detailed vessel history, alerts, and API require a paid FleetMon Explorer/API plan.

additions.name: Copernicus Browser
additions.description: Web-based viewer for Sentinel satellite imagery, letting users browse, compare, and download Copernicus Earth-observation data by date and location.
additions.notes: A free EU Copernicus Data Space account is required to download full-resolution scenes; browsing/preview is open to anyone.

additions.name: NASA Worldview
additions.description: Interactive browser for NASA's near-real-time satellite imagery (MODIS, VIIRS) with overlays including active-fire (FIRMS) hotspot data.
additions.notes: Completely free, no account, as of 2026.

additions.name: Yandex Maps
additions.description: Russian web-mapping service with detailed street maps, satellite imagery, and panoramic street view, with particularly strong Russia/CIS coverage.
additions.notes: Free to use without an account as of 2026.

additions.name: Apple Maps (web)
additions.description: Apple's web-based mapping service offering satellite imagery, directions, and Look Around street-level panoramas.
additions.notes: Free, and no Apple ID is needed for the web version as of 2026.

additions.name: Mapillary
additions.description: Crowdsourced street-level imagery platform, owned by Meta, for browsing geotagged photos and comparing a location's appearance over time.
additions.notes: Free account needed to view full-resolution imagery or contribute; API access is also free but rate-limited.

additions.name: Peakvisor
additions.description: 3D mountain-identification tool and map that names peaks visible in a photo or from a chosen viewpoint, used to geolocate landscape imagery.
additions.notes: Free web viewer with limited peak lookups; the mobile app's full peak database and offline maps are paid.

additions.name: 4CAT
additions.description: Open-source Capture and Analysis Toolkit for downloading and analyzing datasets from social media and forum platforms for research.
additions.notes: Free, open-source software; using it against most platforms still requires the researcher's own API access/credentials for that platform.

additions.name: Bluesky
additions.description: Decentralized microblogging platform (AT Protocol) with public post search, used to research accounts and discussions the way Twitter/X once was.
additions.notes: Free account for full search and posting; the underlying firehose/Jetstream feed is also free and public for developers.

additions.name: SEC EDGAR
additions.description: US Securities and Exchange Commission's full-text and company search over public filings, including 10-Ks, proxy statements, and ownership disclosures.
additions.notes: Fully free and keyless as of 2026; a free API key is only needed for higher-volume automated access.

additions.name: GLEIF LEI Search
additions.description: Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation's search for LEI records, mapping a company's legal identity and ownership relationships worldwide.
additions.notes: Free public search and bulk data download, no account required.

additions.name: Arkham Intelligence
additions.description: Blockchain-intelligence platform that attributes wallet addresses to real-world entities and visualizes fund flows across chains.
additions.notes: Free tier gives basic entity/address lookups; deep attribution history, alerts, and API access require a paid Arkham subscription.

additions.name: Bitquery
additions.description: Blockchain-data API and explorer covering multiple chains, used to query on-chain transactions, transfers, and DEX trades via GraphQL.
additions.notes: Free tier includes a limited monthly API-call allowance; higher volume and premium datasets are paid.

additions.name: Photon
additions.description: Open-source, fast web crawler that extracts URLs, emails, secrets, and other data points from a target site for OSINT and recon.
additions.notes: Free open-source tool; largely unmaintained since ~2022 but still functional as of 2026.

additions.name: ExifTool
additions.description: Command-line application for reading, writing, and editing metadata (EXIF, GPS, IPTC) embedded in images, video, and documents.
additions.notes: Free, open source, and actively maintained as of 2026.

additions.name: yt-dlp
additions.description: Open-source command-line tool for downloading and archiving video/audio from YouTube and hundreds of other platforms, used to preserve evidence.
additions.notes: Free and open source, actively maintained fork of youtube-dl.

additions.name: Hunchly
additions.description: Purpose-built browser-based capture tool for OSINT investigators that automatically screenshots, hashes, and logs every page visited.
additions.notes: Paid software (annual license, roughly $130/year as of 2026); no functional free tier beyond a trial.

additions.name: Trace Labs
additions.description: Non-profit running OSINT Search Party CTF competitions and maintaining a customized OSINT VM, focused on finding missing persons.
additions.notes: Free to join events and download the OSINT VM as of 2026.

additions.name: SANS OSINT & Recon Cheat Sheet
additions.description: SANS reference poster/cheat sheet summarizing OSINT and reconnaissance techniques, tools, and search operators.
additions.notes: Free PDF download, typically gated behind a SANS account/email signup.

additions.name: Wappalyzer
additions.description: Technology-profiling tool that identifies the CMS, frameworks, analytics, and other software running behind a given website.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: free browser-extension lookups are capped per day/month; bulk lookups and the full API require a paid plan.

additions.name: Netcraft Site Report
additions.description: Site-report and hosting-history tool showing a domain's hosting provider, server technology, and uptime history, also used for phishing-takedown intel.
additions.notes: Basic Site Report lookups remain free; threat-intel feeds and takedown services are enterprise/paid.

additions.name: PimEyes
additions.description: Reverse face-search engine that finds other photos of the same face across the indexed web.
additions.notes: Sept 2026: free search confirms matches exist but blurs/withholds most result details and source URLs; viewing full results requires a paid subscription.

additions.name: Namechk
additions.description: Username- and domain-availability checker that scans dozens of platforms simultaneously to see where a given handle is registered.
additions.notes: Free to use; results occasionally show false positives/negatives due to rate limits from checked platforms.

additions.name: Google Hacking Database (GHDB)
additions.description: Curated, searchable archive of Google dorks (search operators) used to surface exposed files, login portals, and misconfigured services.
additions.notes: Free, maintained by Offensive Security as part of Exploit-DB; no account needed.

additions.name: TruePeopleSearch
additions.description: US people-search engine returning names, addresses, phone numbers, and relatives from public records, searchable by name or address.
additions.notes: Free to search and view basic results as of 2026; US-records coverage only.

additions.name: Skiptracer
additions.description: Open-source Python OSINT framework that scrapes people-search and social sites to build a profile from a name, email, or phone number.
additions.notes: Free open-source tool; largely unmaintained since ~2019 and many of the sites it scrapes have since blocked it.
